name: Tonari no Izuki-kun
source:
Just like any other day, Izuki's asking Kanon to marry him.
And just like any other day, she lets it in one ear and out the other.
What's going to happen to their relationship on Valentine's Day?

[Translated from [url=http://lllakolll.xxxxxxxx.jp/2012VG/2012VG.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
和往常一样，居月向花音求婚。
和往常一样，她也只是左耳进右耳出。
在情人节这天，他们的关系会发生什么变化？

[译自[url=http://lllakolll.xxxxxxxx.jp/2012VG/2012VG.html]官方网站[/url]]
